column2: f112639 bar a single tick 12 frames before 12_6 starts at f112651: bar visible 4.05 s. Silence from cue end to next cue 5.07 s. Card unchanged at f112651. f112681 question and summary rows leave, hints stay; f112873 labels only. Passes the hidden-answer rule.
spin 1½: time 0.03/laps 0.04, 0.61/0.92, 0.92/1.38, 1.00/1.50 all equal time × 1.5 within rounding. Dot lands in the big ring, full gold loop for more than one lap. Same end pose as sheet 324.

Hold, then reset with a 0.5 s cross-fade at f113214: faces dim, spin 2½, time 0.00. Timing tight against "and so does two and a half", which begins at f113196 while the old state still shows: about 0.3 s lag, harmless.
spin 2½: 0.02/0.06, 0.17/0.43, 0.47/1.16, 1.00/2.50 agree within rounding. "laps: ½, 1½, 2½, ... all end here" on cue end. Bump at the lower right corner again, P9.
Other way: 0.03/-0.02, 0.45/-0.22, 1.00/-0.50; front edge moves left, arc along the near half of the circle. Same end pose. "direction: ½ lap the other way too" on sentence 2. Correct.

Another axis: red line through opposite edge midpoints, top and front right faces swap, purple comes front left: correct for that half turn. Midpoints of rod top and image, and of the top centre and image, lie on the red line within 2 px: consistent with a true half turn in parallel projection. Corner rings empty at the end while the top centre has left the rod. "axis: only the rod; another axis drags the top off it" correct. Ends about x=853 of 960.
